responsibility_summary: network.coordinator =================== ``CoordinatorDispatcher`` — manages the in-flight registry and serves the coordinator HTTP API on a dedicated ``ThreadingHTTPServer``. Architecture ------------ * Starts its own HTTP server on ``<CoordinatorBindAddress>:<CoordinatorPort>`` so workers on other LAN machines can reach it when the bind address allows LAN traffic.
